subject.title: fix(gateway): recover when suppressed channel secrets are unavailable

question: Should `secrets.reload` continue refusing automatic channel restarts in crash-loop safe mode, or may it stop and restart accounts that an operator already started explicitly?
rationale: Both behaviors are technically implementable, but this changes a documented recovery and operator-control boundary that the linked startup regression does not itself require.

options.title: Keep reload suppression
options.body: Narrow this branch to the startup source/assignment projection fix and preserve explicit `channels.start` as the only safe-mode restart path.

options.title: Approve account-aware reload
options.body: Accept the new restart transaction only after exact-head supervised proof covers successful restart, timeout, rollback, and retry behavior.

options.title: Select the sibling candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106405 as the canonical startup fix if its narrower implementation and proof are preferred.

recommendation.title: Keep reload suppression
recommendation.body: Narrow this branch to the startup source/assignment projection fix and preserve explicit `channels.start` as the only safe-mode restart path.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most directly connects this person to the crash-loop breaker and its safe-mode semantics.
